summary: You have four Riyadh offices, project listings and an app, but a broken WhatsApp link, repeated cards and raw code on an article hurt trust.

findings.problem: The footer WhatsApp link uses wa.me/+971undefined, and it appears twice.
findings.cost: A buyer who taps to message you gets an error and may leave.
findings.fix: A tested WhatsApp button on the right number.

findings.problem: The Exclusive projects cards repeat twice in a row, the property prices by location tabs show no chart or figures, and article FAQ headings have no questions under them.
findings.cost: Repeated and empty sections look unfinished.
findings.fix: Each project shown once and complete content.

findings.problem: Request a Property and List Your Property show no form fields, no reviews appear, and Saudi Arabia's leading real estate broker has no evidence on the page.
findings.cost: Buyers and sellers need an easy form and proof.
findings.fix: Working forms, reviews and evidence for claims.

findings.problem: A blog article shows raw LaTeX code, and typos include Frequntly, Mawtin against Mawten, and delivery lines like Q21 and Q31.
findings.cost: Raw code and typos signal a site no one checks.

redesign: Working request and listing forms, plus a tested WhatsApp button.
Clean project pages, reviews and clear evidence for your claims.
